children.value: > Fact From Story You need to check who your players play and make sure you've got the right guys in -- and the wrong guys out.
> > Fact From Story Fantasy Football is all about the matchups.

> > Fact From Story You should feel more comfortable starting or sitting players based on the information given, and feeling comfortable with your Fantasy lineup before the games start is the best feeling in the world.
> > > Fact From Story It's also important to have a keen eye for matchups dictated by the remaining schedule.
> > > Fact From Story Fantasy Football is all about the matchups.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Fantasy football lineup decisions should be based on matchups.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Knowing the matchups helps you decide who to start or sit in your Fantasy lineup.
> Fact From Story Even though you drafted your team with certain hopes and intentions, your weekly lineup decisions shouldn't be determined by the order you picked your players in.

> > Fact From Story You should feel more comfortable starting or sitting players based on the information given, and feeling comfortable with your Fantasy lineup before the games start is the best feeling in the world.
> > Fact From Story You need to check who your players play and make sure you've got the right guys in -- and the wrong guys out.
> > > Fact From Story Fantasy Football is all about the matchups.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Lineup decisions should be based on the current week's matchups.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Fantasy football lineup decisions are not about the order you drafted players, but about current matchups and performance.
> Commonsense Knowledge Checking matchups is important for making informed fantasy football decisions.
